protocol: Five independent facts (A identity, B domicile, C trading, D market relevance, E 90-day liveness). Regulatory registers alone never suffice.
auditPolicy: Entries marked pipeline-sourced carry production-pipeline verdicts only (country + trading decisions with confidence). They validate HARNESS mechanics, never published recall claims. Entries become five-point-audited only after independent per-fact evidence is attached. Anything else is backlog, not ground truth.

backlog.negatives: distractor set not yet collected (generic finance, news, motivation, gaming)
